create_waterparked.ponder.ponder_connect: Right-click two waterslide anchors with a waterslide track to connect them
A waterslide spline is created between the two anchors
A wrench can be used to adjust the path of the spline
create_waterparked.ponder.slide_ponder_0: Right-click two waterslide anchors with a waterslide track......
Some controls of the waterslide work exactly like coaster track.
A wrench can be used to adjust the path of the slide
Drag left and right to adjust the tube opening size
create_waterparked.ponder.slide_ponder_1: Right-click two waterslide anchors with a block......
A sector with the corresponding block texture can be added.
Right-click two waterslide anchors with an axe......
An empty sector can be added.
You can use a wrench to adjust the position and size of sectors
create_waterparked.ponder.slide_ponder_2: Hold a wrench in your main hand and a block in your offhand......
A ghost block is placed, hugging the outside of the tube wall.
Ghost blocks follow the curve of the slide.
Right-clicking with an axe removes ghost blocks......
